title: benzoin umbellatum var. hypoglaucum
intro: Benzoin umbellatum var. hypoglaucum, commonly known as the small-leaved styrax, is a plant species in the family Styracaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to treat various conditions such as wounds, burns, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of the small-leaved styrax include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and wound-healing properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
